searchText: Is the following point of 7702 already tested in the execution spec test? > If transaction execution results in failure (any exceptional condition or code reverting), setting delegation designations is not rolled back. I have not yet implemented it in Besu and 5 tests are still failing, but none of them seems to be related to keeping an auth after a failed transaction. Delegation clearing is covered by this test, but as I understand it, it looks like it's not consistent with this point ("setting delegations is not rolled back"). - https://ethereum.github.io/execution-spec-tests/pectra-devnet-4@v1.0.1/tests/prague/eip7702_set_code_tx/test_set_code_txs/test_delegation_clearing_failing_tx/ <@508125616940515329> could you take a look? Have I misinterpreted something here? (Mario's ooo until next week, btw.) I will check, I am fairly certain that the delegation happens also if the execution fails 🙂 Could you list the tests which fail? I just checked: This test; `test_delegation_clearing_failing_tx[fork_Prague-blockchain_test-out_of_gas]` Has 0xa94 delegated to 0x00..001000 pre-state Has one tx: sets 0xa94 to 0x00..00 as delegation (so clears delegation) This tx itself runs OOG The post-state has 0xa94 cleared of 0x00.001000 (so code is now empty). Plus the nonce is bumped from 0x01 -> 0x02. This should be included in the fixtures which were released (at least 1.0.0, not sure if 1.0.1 was also filled by EthJS) All right, thanks! Both `pectra-devnet-4@0v1.0.0` and `pectra-devnet-4@0v1.0.1` were filled with ethjs. There are no differences in the fixtures for this particular test `test_delegation_clearing_failing_tx` across 1.0.0 and 1.0.1. Btw, if you have the fixtures handy, you can check the `_info` section, which will tell you which `t8n` filled them: ```json "_info": { "hash": "0xc4e7570d49dc12136d4505591b06193d5219f52a290f16cad92a74193604e799", "comment": "`execution-spec-tests` generated test", "filling-transition-tool": "ethereumjs t8n v1", "description": "Test function documentation:\n\n Test clearing the delegation of an account in a transaction that fails, OOGs or reverts.", "url": "https://github.com/ethereum/execution-spec-tests/blob/pectra-devnet-4@v1.0.1/tests/prague/eip7702_set_code_tx/test_set_code_txs.py#L3055", "reference-spec": "https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/master/EIPS/eip-7702.md", "reference-spec-version": "4334df83395693dc3f629bb43c18320d9e22e8c9" } ``` Ah great 😄 Yes I have not yet ran 1.0.1 on our side but if we filled them we should pass (although this could be a nice sanity check, if we fill tests also make sure we pass them, since our filler != our test runner 🙂 ) We also pass 1.0.1. I should add a EthJS commit to the filler version of t8n / repo (it's now a stub "v1" 🙂 )

excerpts.author: daniellehrner
excerpts.content:
Is the following point of 7702 already tested in the execution spec test?

> If transaction execution results in failure (any exceptional condition or code reverting), setting delegation designations is not rolled back.

I have not yet implemented it in Besu and 5 tests are still failing, but none of them seems to be related to keeping an auth after a failed transaction.

excerpts.author: danceratopz
excerpts.content:
Delegation clearing is covered by this test, but as I understand it, it looks like it's not consistent with this point ("setting delegations is not rolled back").
- https://ethereum.github.io/execution-spec-tests/pectra-devnet-4@v1.0.1/tests/prague/eip7702_set_code_tx/test_set_code_txs/test_delegation_clearing_failing_tx/

<@508125616940515329> could you take a look? Have I misinterpreted something here? (Mario's ooo until next week, btw.)

excerpts.author: jochembrouwer
excerpts.content: I will check, I am fairly certain that the delegation happens also if the execution fails 🙂

excerpts.author: jochembrouwer
excerpts.content: Could you list the tests which fail?

excerpts.author: jochembrouwer
excerpts.content:
I just checked:

This test; `test_delegation_clearing_failing_tx[fork_Prague-blockchain_test-out_of_gas]`

Has 0xa94 delegated to 0x00..001000 pre-state
Has one tx: sets 0xa94 to 0x00..00 as delegation (so clears delegation)
This tx itself runs OOG
The post-state has 0xa94 cleared of 0x00.001000 (so code is now empty). Plus the nonce is bumped from 0x01 -> 0x02. This should be included in the fixtures which were released (at least 1.0.0, not sure if 1.0.1 was also filled by EthJS)

excerpts.author: danceratopz
excerpts.content:
All right, thanks! Both `pectra-devnet-4@0v1.0.0` and `pectra-devnet-4@0v1.0.1` were filled with ethjs. There are no differences in the fixtures for this particular test `test_delegation_clearing_failing_tx` across 1.0.0 and 1.0.1.
